svg.aria-label: A Series is one column of values with an index: s2 has the labels Adam, Eve, Charlie and Bob and the values 23 to 26, so s2['Eve'] is 24. A DataFrame is a table whose rows share one index (0, 1, 2) and whose columns have labels (Name, Marks, Grade); each column, such as df['Marks'], is itself a Series.
svg.title: Series and DataFrame
